<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Subscription" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/subscription">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Subscription" name="Subscription Lifecycle" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Subscription">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_SignUp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterInfo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CancelRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_System" name="Subscription System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Billing_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunBilling</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CancelDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Support" name="Support Team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessCancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Adjustment_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyRefund</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ApplyCharge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Settlement_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeactivateSubscription</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SettleBalance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Concluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SignUp" name="Customer signs up for subscription"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterInfo" name="Enter personal and payment information"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateAccount" name="Generate account and assign access"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Billing_Merge" name="Merge"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RunBilling" name="Trigger automated billing cycle"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send updates, enhancements or renewal notifications"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CancelDecision" name="Customer decides to cancel?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CancelRequest" name="Submit cancellation request"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProcessCancel" name="Process cancellation request"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" name="Refund or charge per terms?" default="Flow_NoAdjustment"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApplyRefund" name="Apply refund"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ApplyCharge" name="Apply charge"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Settlement_Merge" name="Merge"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DeactivateSubscription" name="Deactivate subscription"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SettleBalance" name="Settle final account balance"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Concluded" name="Subscription concluded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SignUp" sourceRef="StartEvent_SignUp" targetRef="Task_EnterInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InfoEntered" sourceRef="Task_EnterInfo" targetRef="Task_GenerateAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountCreated" sourceRef="Task_GenerateAccount" targetRef="Gateway_Billing_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToBilling" sourceRef="Gateway_Billing_Merge" targetRef="Task_RunBilling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingToUpdates" sourceRef="Task_RunBilling" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdatesToDecision" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_CancelDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoCancel" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CancelDecision" targetRef="Gateway_Billing_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cancel" name="Cancellation requested" sourceRef="Gateway_CancelDecision" targetRef="Task_CancelRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestToProcess" sourceRef="Task_CancelRequest" targetRef="Task_ProcessCancel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProcessToSplit" sourceRef="Task_ProcessCancel" targetRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refund" name="Refund due" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Charge" name="Charge due" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" targetRef="Task_ApplyCharge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdjustment" name="No adjustment" sourceRef="Gateway_Adjustment_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Settlement_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyRefund" targetRef="Gateway_Settlement_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChargeToMerge" sourceRef="Task_ApplyCharge" targetRef="Gateway_Settlement_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDeactivate" sourceRef="Gateway_Settlement_Merge" targetRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSettle" sourceRef="Task_DeactivateSubscription" targetRef="Task_SettleBalance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEnd" sourceRef="Task_SettleBalance" targetRef="EndEvent_Concluded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
